name: Federation Radar
description: Lists the instances your server federates with. Switch the view with a select: most delivered / recently communicated / newly federated / in trouble (not responding or suspended). Each row shows 📤 how many of their users follow yours, 📥 how many of yours follow theirs, and the status. Click a row for a dialog with software, size, last communication and more. Remembers the selection and refreshes every 10 minutes. No token setup required.
